strengths_deep_dive: Islamic Relief USA exhibits exceptional financial resilience, holding <cite id="13">18.0 months of working capital</cite> in working capital. This liquidity allows the organization to sustain operations during revenue fluctuations, such as the <cite id="4">11% decline in revenue</cite> observed between FY2023 and FY2024. Furthermore, the organization's commitment to transparency is evidenced by its <cite id="3">Candid Platinum Seal</cite> and its detailed <cite id="16">tracking of outcome metrics</cite> like food distribution and health service restoration.
rich_narrative.summary: founded in 1994, Islamic Relief USA (IRUSA) has established itself as a major humanitarian institution, providing <cite id="1">direct aid and food assistance</cite> to vulnerable families across the globe. The organization operates with a high degree of transparency, maintaining a <cite id="2">97/100 overall score from Charity Navigator</cite> and a <cite id="3">Platinum Seal of Transparency from Candid</cite>. In FY2024, the organization reported <cite id="4">total revenue of $147,232,658</cite>, representing a decrease from the previous year's <cite id="5">$165,235,589 in revenue</cite>. Despite this recent decline, IRUSA maintains a significant operational footprint, reaching regions including <cite id="6">Gaza, Yemen, and Syria</cite>. The charity is <cite id="7">fully zakat-eligible</cite>, distributing funds across all eight traditional asnaf categories. Financial efficiency remains a core strength, as the organization directs <cite id="8">80.3% of its expenses to programs</cite>, which exceeds the <cite id="9">industry standard of 75%</cite>. However, this ratio is slightly below the <cite id="10">peer median of 89.8%</cite> for similar humanitarian organizations. IRUSA's model focuses on direct service delivery, ranging from <cite id="11">distributing 187,563 food parcels</cite> to <cite id="12">restoring health services for 1.5 million people</cite>. While the organization demonstrates strong financial health with <cite id="13">18.0 months of working capital</cite>, its governance structure is relatively lean for its size, currently operating with a <cite id="14">four-member board of directors</cite>.
